name: OpenSCM SCML
description: External tool profile for editing SCML-style scripts in Sanny Builder and compiling them to .scmlbin without changing the SCML language.
notes: Use Sanny Builder as an editor/frontend only.
Keep GTA-specific commands in GTA Integration/scmlh/*.scmlh.
Load generated .scmlbin files from the CLEO/ASI runtime host.
